completed: Committed and pushed P0.0 and P0.1 to origin/main (the push raced twice against another process actively committing knowledge-library ingestion; merged cleanly each time).
Implemented P0.2 / EXEC-0.5 selective profile retrieval in src/agent_os/profile.py: profile/ is flattened into 105 addressable facts carrying domain, provenance, confidence, sensitivity and recency.

Merged profile retrieval into the context compiler as an automatic profile_context section, pruned below task-selected project material, with the empty diagnostics shell dropped entirely under budget pressure.

Exposed retrieval through CLI (profile-status, profile-retrieve) and MCP (profile.retrieve, profile.status); validate now indexes the profile and fails on any retrievable fact carrying a privacy finding.
Added tests/test_profile.py: 31 regression tests covering relevance filtering, privacy exclusion, deduplication, superseded and stale facts, budgets, diagnostics, and compiler integration.
Documented the design in docs/selective-profile-retrieval.md and recorded four new debt items in the technical-debt register.
decisions: drive-derived-context.json is excluded from retrieval: it is a 60KB derived index, not curated durable context, and loading it would reintroduce the bulk injection this work exists to prevent.

Relevance requires a distinctive signal - domain vocabulary or more than one matched term - so a single shared generic word cannot route a coding task into personal context. This mirrors the project router's existing rule.
Privacy is enforced at retrieval rather than trusted to the author, so no caller can reach restricted material by forgetting to filter.
remaining: Relevance is lexical; DOMAIN_TERMS needs curation as the profile grows, and an unnamed personal dimension is missed silently.
drive-derived-context.json remains inert; its value is neither distilled into durable facts nor indexed.
Confidence and recency are file-level, not fact-level, so the supersede rule is coarser than it could be.
No profile-specific promotion rule yet for turning conversational observations into durable profile facts.
Next roadmap item is P0.3 shared document intelligence and the local persistent extraction/OCR cache.
